gameGrid.title: Crossing Grid
gameGrid.intro: A 3×3 grid has conditions on each row and column. Think of a person who satisfies both conditions at once and type their name. Fill all 9 cells to complete a round.
gameGrid.mobileRuleSummary: Tap a cell → type a name → correct if both row and column conditions are met
gameGrid.notEnoughData: Not enough data to generate a puzzle
gameGrid.fixtureMode: ⚠ Demo Mode — running on sample data

rules.gridBody: Three rows and three columns, each with a condition. Nationality, profession, century, or faction — two axes cross.
rules.recallBody: No choices given. Think of someone who fits both conditions and type their name.
rules.scoreBody: Fill all 9 cells to finish. You cannot use the same person twice.
